items.title: Succinct generators for a three-tensor torus action would imply NP is contained in P/poly
items.author: Ankit Garg; Christian Ikenmeyer; Visu Makam; Rafael Oliveira; Michael Walter; Avi Wigderson
items.source_version: CCC2020 official complete17-page six-author CC BY3.0 Unported publication; mainTheorem8/completeSection3 torus counterexample, formalDefinitions3/4 andSection2 included. Nativev2 private aid only.
items.difficulty_reason: The argument identifies degree-n minimal invariants with perfect three-dimensional-matching monomials, extracts that entire span from any succinct encoding without blowing up constant complexity, and converts specialization to a rational-circuit PIT instance giving a nonuniform algorithm for an NP-complete problem.

proof_spans.label: EntireSection3 author reduction and fullProposition21 matching-invariant proof
